text: The radar shall detect targets within .5/2.0 nm and shall classify them (friend or foe) and it shall not miss any target under all weather conditions.
A display shall be updated by the system periodically and it shall show all relevant data as appropriate and it shall refresh eventually.
The unit shall operate at .5/1.0 rating (approx.) under nominal load and it shall not exceed the limit.
The system shall be user friendly and shall generally handle all inputs quickly and efficiently as appropriate.
The navigation system shall generally provide accurate position data as needed and it shall update periodically and shall optimize accuracy for best results.
The ground station shall receive telemetry from the aircraft and it shall not lose any packets under normal and abnormal conditions and it shall buffer all data.
When the altitude drops below 500 ft and the gear is not down, the system shall alert the pilot and log the event and notify ATC quickly and it shall record the data.
The system shall not fail under all conditions and shall always maintain full control and it shall never lose data.
The system shall handle typical fault conditions, etc., unless otherwise specified, and it shall recover and it shall notify the operator.
The system shall detect anomalies (including but not limited to sensor faults) and shall log them accordingly and it shall notify the operator.
A warning message shall be displayed by the interface when an error is detected, and it shall be logged and it shall be cleared eventually.
The system shall be capable of being reconfigured by the operator and shall support various modes as needed and it shall adapt automatically.
The system shall accept commands from the operator and it shall execute them and shall confirm completion, etc. and it shall log all activity.
The flight computer shall maintain roll, pitch and yaw stability at all times and shall never exceed safe limits and it shall always respond instantly.
The software shall generally avoid excessive memory usage and shall try to respond fast and it shall optimize CPU usage.
When power is applied or the reset button is pressed, the system shall initialize various subsystems in order to ensure readiness and it shall log the event, etc.
The subsystem shall periodically check status and shall optimize resource allocation to maximize throughput and it shall generally log everything.
The autopilot shall optimize flight path efficiency for best performance and shall generally minimize fuel usage as needed and it shall adapt eventually.
The system is supposed to detect this condition as needed and shall respond appropriately and it shall notify the crew and shall log all events and it shall never fail.
The controller shall detect the fault and shall isolate it and shall notify the crew promptly and it shall log everything, etc. and it shall always recover.

The interface shall be intuitive and the response shall be fast and the system shall be reliable and it shall be user friendly and it shall never fail and it shall always work and it shall generally satisfy the user.

If the battery is low, the system shall quickly reduce power and shall notify the user and it shall log the event and it shall alert the crew and it shall always respond and it shall never delay and it shall generally conserve energy.
